translation: Teleskop bizga Oyni ko‘rsatdi, lekin hech qanday pishloqni ochib bermadi.

example: Clean the lens before announcing that every star has a fingerprint.
translation: Har bir yulduzda barmoq izi borligini e’lon qilishdan oldin linzani tozalang.

example: The test tube was tiny, but our excitement was enormous.
translation: Probirka kichkina edi, hayajonimiz esa ulkan.

example: The thermometer confirmed that the classroom was warmer than our welcome.
translation: Termometr sinfxona kutib olishimizdan ham iliqroq ekanini tasdiqladi.

example: The lab was twenty degrees Celsius, but my tea had other plans.
translation: Laboratoriyada harorat yigirma daraja Selsiy edi, lekin choyimning rejalari boshqacha edi.

example: A millimetre sounds tiny until your robot misses a doorway by one.
translation: Robot eshikdan bir millimetr tufayli o‘tolmay qolmaguncha, bu birlik juda kichik tuyuladi.

example: Write the unit beside the number, or your bridge might be three bananas long.
translation: Raqam yoniga o‘lchov birligini yozing, aks holda ko‘prigingiz uch banan uzunlikda bo‘lishi mumkin.

example: We measured the length of the cable before celebrating its usefulness.
translation: Kabelning foydaliligini nishonlashdan oldin uzunligini o‘lchadik.

example: The width of the robot matters when the classroom door is narrow.
translation: Sinfxona eshigi tor bo‘lsa, robotning kengligi muhim bo‘ladi.

example: The height of our paper tower impressed everyone until someone sneezed.
translation: Kimdir aksirguncha qog‘oz minoramizning balandligi hammani qoyil qoldirdi.

meaning: diametr; aylana markazidan o‘tuvchi kesma uzunligi
example: We measured the diameter of the wheel before discovering it would not fit our robot.
translation: G‘ildirak robotimizga sig‘masligini bilishdan oldin uning diametrini o‘lchadik.

example: The weight of the books bent our experimental cardboard shelf.
translation: Kitoblarning og‘irligi tajriba uchun yasalgan karton tokchamizni egib qo‘ydi.

example: One extra centimetre made our model too wide for its carefully built box.
translation: Bitta ortiqcha santimetr maketimizni puxta yasalgan qutisiga sig‘maydigan darajada keng qilib qo‘ydi.

example: The robot's speed increased after we removed the unnecessary toy passenger.
translation: Keraksiz o‘yinchoq yo‘lovchini olib tashlagach, robotning tezligi oshdi.

example: The average rose sharply when we included the headteacher's enormous bookshelf.
translation: Direktorning ulkan kitob javonini qo‘shganimizda o‘rtacha qiymat keskin oshdi.

example: The total includes every survey response, even the one written in purple crayon.
translation: Jami miqdorga har bir so‘rov javobi, hatto binafsha mumqalamda yozilgani ham kiradi.

example: The maximum was twelve clicks, which seemed a lot for opening one file.
translation: Eng katta miqdor o‘n ikki marta bosish bo‘ldi, bu bitta faylni ochish uchun ko‘pdek tuyuldi.

example: The minimum was two seconds, set by someone who clearly wanted lunch.
translation: Eng kichik vaqt ikki soniya bo‘ldi, uni tushlikni juda xohlagan kimdir qayd etdi.

example: My diagram explains the machine better than my excited hand movements.
translation: Chizmam uskunani hayajonli qo‘l harakatlarimdan yaxshiroq tushuntiradi.

example: The chart shows that our coffee use rises with the number of meetings.
translation: Diagramma yig‘ilishlar soni oshishi bilan qahva iste’molimiz ham oshishini ko‘rsatadi.

example: The graph went up so steeply that someone drew a tiny climber on it.
translation: Grafik shunchalik tik ko‘tarildiki, kimdir unga mitti alpinist chizdi.

example: The graph shows a clear trend: fewer people answer surveys on Friday afternoons.
translation: Grafik aniq yo‘nalishni ko‘rsatadi: juma kuni tushdan keyin so‘rovlarga kamroq odam javob beradi.
